title: Sampling Procedure
text: Controlled QC sampling procedure. Verify current revision, training evidence, sampling plan and applicable deviations before presentation.

title: Cleaning Procedure
text: Controlled manufacturing cleaning procedure. Verify current revision, cleaning records, deviations and CAPA links.

title: Change-Control Rationale
text: Change-control evidence should include rationale, impact assessment, approval history and linked CAPA when applicable.
